howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的需求生成 EdgeOne Makers 项目的目录结构和代码模板，包括全栈应用、静态站点、API 服务或 AI 代理项目。
howto.when: 当你要求创建 EdgeOne Makers 项目，或询问项目结构模板时触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate directory structures and code templates for EdgeOne Makers projects, including full-stack apps, static sites, API services, or AI agent projects.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create an EdgeOne Makers project or request project structure templates.

say_en.text: Create a Node.js full-stack app template.
Create an Edge API project with KV counter.
